summary: This Form 6-K filed by Osisko Development Corp. reports the intended satisfaction of the fourth deferred payment installment (US$2.5M) in common shares to sellers of the Tintic Project, originally acquired in May 2022. The payment is a routine contractual obligation under a prior acquisition agreement, not a new special situation. It does not constitute a new acquisition, divestiture, or other special event. The share issuance (871,683 shares at ~C$3.9613 per share) is subject to TSX Venture Exchange approval. This is purely a scheduled earn-out or deferred consideration fulfillment with no premium, advisor, or board recommendation involved.
